cohort: 570 pregnant women with anaemia who gave birth in five hospitals in the Lagos metropolis of Nigeria, from the 'Predict-PPH' study (January-June 2023)
finding: Maternal obesity, antepartum bleeding in the current pregnancy, co-existing uterine fibroids in pregnancy, delivery gestational age beyond 38 weeks, and caesarean birth in the current pregnancy were significantly associated with severe PPH in anaemic pregnant women.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth in the current pregnancy was significantly associated with severe PPH in anaemic pregnant women.
